title: 连专家都：低估了这轮，盈利复苏的强度
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Do you feel like you've got the market right if you underestimated its durability?
segments.zh: 如果你低估了市场的持久性，你是否觉得自己判断对了？

segments.en: No, I think we probably were the first one to talk about this earnings recovery, and even we underestimated the strength of it.
segments.zh: 不，我们可能是最早谈论盈利复苏的，但即便如此，我们也低估了它的力度。

segments.en: So yes, we did underestimate the power of it, but with directionally, I think we were right on that.
segments.zh: 所以，我们确实低估了它的力量，但从方向上看，我认为我们是对的。

segments.en: I think what we've been surprised is probably the durability of the AI CapEx and just how much that has accelerated and how much, quite frankly, how much the market has been willing to absorb
segments.zh: 让我们惊讶的是AI资本开支的持久性，以及它加速的程度，还有市场愿意吸收的程度。

segments.en: on the issuance. The reason you've been good at that is Jim Karen, it's got nothing to do with the equity side.
segments.zh: 关于发行，你之所以擅长，是因为吉姆·卡伦，这与权益资产无关。

segments.en: The shop, bring up the chart right now. This is the emotion. Many of you have forgotten this.
segments.zh: 现在调出图表。这就是情绪。很多人已经忘了这个。

segments.en: Stocks, you can go down and stocks. It's a shock.
segments.zh: 权益资产可能会下跌，这很令人震惊。

segments.en: Now this chart ends in 2022, but there's XPS.
segments.zh: 这张图到2022年结束，但还有XPS。

segments.en: It's wonderful, great, wonderful, COVID and all that.
segments.zh: 太棒了，太好了，还有新冠疫情等等。

segments.en: And then there's a big roll over in 2021-22, where are you brave enough to catch the falling knife?
segments.zh: 然后在2021-22年有一个大转折，你敢接飞刀吗？

segments.en: Look at rolls over like that, and my personal finance has troubled.
segments.zh: 像那样回落，我的个人财务也遇到了麻烦。

segments.en: How do I get back into the market? How at the margin do you buy when you see the sweat of that chart?
segments.zh: 我如何重新进入市场？当你看到图表上的波动时，如何在边缘买入？

segments.en: Well, the really challenging thing of 2022, as you know, for retirees, was that stocks and bonds went down for the first time in really our lifetime, so there was no head.
segments.zh: 2022年真正棘手的是，正如你所知，对退休人员来说，权益资产和债券首次在我们有生之年同时下跌，所以没有避险之处。

segments.en: So even though the decline in equities wasn't as severe as it was in 08 or in 01 or 02, your 6040 portfolio was down the same.
segments.zh: 因此，尽管权益资产的跌幅没有08年或01年、02年那么严重，但你的60/40组合跌幅相同。
